title: Whether college bands were true jazz bands; jazz passed him by
summary: Pressed on whether the college bands were bona fide jazz bands, he says he is not competent to define it; jazz passed him by without his opposing or joining it.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
